method: TF-IDF (1-2 grams) retrieval over section-level chunks; questions generated from templates with a known gold document.
caveat: Templated questions name the tenant/property/market explicitly, so keyword retrieval finds them easily; near-perfect scores are an upper bound. Paraphrased or multi-document questions (e.g. 'which leases expire soonest?') will score lower and would need embeddings, a re-ranker and a hand-written question set to measure properly.
